# .github/workflows/release.yml
# Starts a store build on EAS, by hand only: a developer picks the platform under Actions > release >
# Run workflow, and the protected "production" environment (Settings > Environments: required
# reviewers, main only) holds EXPO_TOKEN and waits for a reviewer's approval before anything runs.
# The release preflight (eas-build-and-submit) runs first: a clean tree on main, `npm run verify`,
# the app config and the fingerprint. The build is not submitted here; submitting to a store is the
# developer's next, separate step. No cache is restored in a job that holds a secret.
name: release

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      platform:
        description: Which store build to start
        type: choice
        options: [all, ios, android]
        default: all

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

env:
  LEFTHOOK: '0'
  EXPO_NO_TELEMETRY: '1'

jobs:
  eas-build:
    name: eas build (production)
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 45
    environment: production
    steps:
      - name: Check out with the release tags
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: Set up Node from .nvmrc (no cache in a job with secrets)
        uses: actions/setup-node@820762786026740c76f36085b0efc47a31fe5020 # v7.0.0
        with:
          node-version-file: .nvmrc
          package-manager-cache: false
      - name: Install the locked dependencies
        run: npm ci
      - name: Install the pinned EAS CLI with the dependency policy
        run: npm install -g --min-release-age=7 --ignore-scripts eas-cli@24.10.0
      - name: Release preflight
        run: node scripts/eas/release-preflight.ts --profile production --platform "$PLATFORM"
        env:
          PLATFORM: ${{ inputs.platform }}
      - name: Start the EAS build
        run: >-
          eas build --profile production --platform "$PLATFORM" --non-interactive
          --freeze-credentials --no-wait --message "release from $GITHUB_SHA"
        env:
          PLATFORM: ${{ inputs.platform }}
          EXPO_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.EXPO_TOKEN }}
